rulings.challenge_claim: The row argues its opening echo from the weaker of two available byte-tier anchors and expressly declines the digit that would settle it, and its syntactic-continuity argument turns on a word the row never quotes.
rulings.grounds: Independently re-derived via sweep.py --skel: the longer run לִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֔ה (oshb:Eccl.8.16, byte tier) matches oshb:Eccl.1.17's לִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֔ה at byte tier -- a 2-verse book-wide match (oshb:Eccl.1.17, oshb:Eccl.8.16), confirmed by direct sweep. The shorter run (heart-plus-infinitive without the wisdom noun) returns 3 verses at byte tier: oshb:Eccl.1.17, oshb:Eccl.7.25 (וְלִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת), oshb:Eccl.8.16. The row's own boundary_rationale and device_notes cite only the bare infinitive לָדַ֣עַת and only the oshb:Eccl.7.25 site, framing the link as joining 'this part's two quest-register passages' and explicitly stating it is held 'without being counted into any book-wide sweep.' Both digits it declines are available, small, and clean (2 verses for the longer run including oshb:Eccl.1.17 -- inside the SAME F1/M parent architecture as a heart-applied quest report -- and 3 verses for the shorter run), and running either would both strengthen the row's own claim and correct its 'two-site' framing to three. Second, the row's strongest_rejected_alternative rests on the claim that oshb:Eccl.8.17's own opening word grammatically continues oshb:Eccl.8.16's preceding temporal clause. That word is וְרָאִיתִי֮ (byte tier); the row never quotes it anywhere -- its own Hebrew splice from oshb:Eccl.8.17 begins later in the verse (לֹ֨א יוּכַ֜ל הָאָדָ֗ם לִמְצוֹא֙...) -- so the continuity justification for holding this two-verse unit together stands as an unquoted grammatical assertion, in a book whose staged extract carries no morphology layer to verify it independently.
rulings.remedy: Run and cite the book-wide sweep for both the longer heart-know-wisdom run (2 verses: oshb:Eccl.1.17, oshb:Eccl.8.16) and the shorter heart-plus-infinitive run (3 verses: oshb:Eccl.1.17, oshb:Eccl.7.25, oshb:Eccl.8.16), correcting the 'two-site' framing to three and, if the writer prefers the fuller anchor, re-pointing the echo to oshb:Eccl.1.17 (same F1/M-adjacent quest-report register) rather than only oshb:Eccl.7.25. Quote וְרָאִיתִי֮ explicitly in strongest_rejected_alternative before asserting the grammatical-continuation claim, or soften the claim to a texture note pending morphological confirmation outside the staged tools. Test: a book-wide sweep citation must accompany both digit claims (2 verses / 3 verses, unit and object named), and the continuity claim's own cited word must appear in the row's quoted Hebrew span.
